# Fallout 76 - Patch notes July 18, 2023 (Patch 45)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_191_nukaknights-post-patchnotes45.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# FALLOUT 76 PATCHNOTES – JULY 18, 2023

Our latest update for Fallout 76 is released today, bringing with it a whole host of bug fixes, gameplay improvements and much more. Read on to check out the full patch notes for today's update.

## UPDATE VERSION AND DOWNLOAD SIZE

##### 1.7.5.4

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 2.4GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 10.3GB
**PlayStation:** 9.7GB
**Xbox:** 10.2GB

## BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS

##### AUDIO

**Items:** Audio fixes to various C.A.M.P. items.
**Skills:** Music will now play when opening the skill card menu.
##### ANIMATIONS

**Reload:** Fixed a bug in the reload animation that occurred when using the Extra Large Magazine Mod with the Gatling Laser.
**Armor:** The Asbestos Lined mod now increases fire resistance instead of energy resistance.
**Lifesaving Mod:** Fixed a bug that caused the Legendary Lifesaving Armor mod to not apply Stimpak healing effects, leaving players at 1HP.
**Gauss Minigun:** Fixed the weapon spin animation on certain capacitors equipped.
**Heavy Weapon:** While wearing the Enlightened Cultist Robe, the Heavy Weapon draw animation no longer occurs.
**Popcorn Emote:** The character's mouth will now open when using the Popcorn Emote in Power Armor when no helmet is equipped.
**Power Armor:** Jetpacks no longer disappear from the animation when entering power armor.
**Warglaive:** Fixed the animation of the strong warglaive attack from the first person perspective.
##### C.A.M.P. AND WORKSHOP

**Allies:** Steven Scarberry and Joey Bello now have dialogue when speaking to other players using the C.A.M.P. visit where they are placed.
**Build Mode:** In Build Mode, all plushies now have a thumbnail of the same size.
**Display Cases:** The eggs in the large bird's nest display case have been adjusted.
**Filing Cabinets:** All filing cabinets will no longer float when the supporting structure beneath them is removed.
**Foundations:** Navigation issues with various terrace foundations have been resolved.
**Guard Posts:** In the build menu, all Brotherhood of Steel Sentry Posts are now on the same list.
**Waidmann Bed:** Players no longer get stuck in the frame of the Waidmann Bed.
**Monster Tubes:** In Build mode, all Monster Tubes previews are oriented the same way.
**Movie Sets:** The various movie set facade pieces can now be clicked together.
**Prefabricated Structures:** The Last Stand prefabricated structure no longer lacks the passive power supply at the rear of the engine on the roof.
##### CHALLENGES

**Daily Challenges:** Modifying a Plasma Cutter now counts toward the Modify a Laser Weapon Daily Challenge.
**Daily Challenges:** Challenges that require the use of improvised weapons now also work with improvised melee weapons.
**Epic:** Fixed a bug where the “Make Beer Mugs (Different Versions)” challenge also counted identical versions of Beer Mugs.
##### DAILY OPERATIONS

**Contextual Ammo:** Players can now obtain Diluted Stimpaks as contextual ammo when using melee weapons in Daily Operations.
##### EXPEDITIONS

**Union Contributions:** Fixed a bug that caused no warning to be issued when attempting to speak to a busy NPC.
##### ITEMS

**Armor:** The name of the Free States Resistance
